body:
PARENA/stdlib/idunapro/cli_mod.prn (real match/Result health-check decision logic) compiled via 'burrow build -o *.go' into IDUNA_PRO/internal/burrowgen/idunapro_cli_gen.go, driven by a new real Go host binary IDUNA_PRO/cmd/idunapro/main.go ('idunapro health <base-url>'). No cgo/FFI boundary. Live-verified against IDUNA's real running :8080 instance (healthy -> exit 0, 'IDUNA_PRO instance is healthy') and against a real unreachable host (connection-refused message, exit 1) -- both success and failure paths of the compiled decision logic driving a real process exit code. PARENA commit d5e4696, IDUNA_PRO commit 10f9d98. go test ./... clean in both repos, PARENA's own 342-test suite unaffected. Real, honest scope: one subcommand, not a CLI framework -- kanban card 9988 ('emily for business CLI written in GO with BURROW') stays open since defenum/loop/Vec/struct construction remain unstarted in BURROW's Go target.

⚓ ☃
title: Real v0 CLI proof-of-concept: match/Result BURROW port proven end-to-end via idunapro health
